params.name: user-id
params.description: Filter by user ID associated with the access audit entry.

params.name: user-email
params.description: Filter by email address associated with the access audit entry.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by type of access event (LOGIN, LOGOUT, LOGIN_FAILED, CREDENTIALS_ROLLED, TOKEN_ROLLED).

params.name: created-min
params.description: Minimum created timestamp of the access audit in milliseconds since the Unix epoch (inclusive).

params.name: created-max
params.description: Maximum created timestamp of the access audit in milliseconds since the Unix epoch (inclusive).

params.name: page
params.description: The zero-indexed page number (must not be less than 0, defaults to 0)

params.name: size
params.description: The size of the page and maximum number of items to be returned (must not be less than 1, defaults to 20)

items.docs:
**Permissions:** [Productivity Entitlement](https://help.logicgate.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402683139348-Module-Entitlements-for-Roles)

Retrieve a page of all access audits.
